arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kneedler stated the Secretary approved lease amendments in 1987.
Mr. Frye argued the Government has not accepted the Mitchell II principle.
Mr. Frye stated federal control of Indian property implies trust duties.
Mr. Kneedler argued the tribe knew the substance of the Secretary's actions.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on whether federal control of Indian property creates a trust duty. The Navajo Nation argues this control implies such duties. The United States disputes this legal principle.
